verdict.rationale: Alloy's developer docs introduction references an SDK ('Explore the different features of our SDK'), so a first-party SDK appears to exist. That is a single thin mention, and nothing in the pack shows what it covers or how to build against it. The 404 probes concern llms.txt and doc-path variants, not SDKs, so they are not counted. Missing for 10: supported languages/platforms, SDK scope and API coverage, install and usage documentation, versioning/maintenance details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
